document_title: Informe sectorial de producción y energía 2025 / public summary
publisher: Asociación Española de Fabricantes de Azulejos y Pavimentos Cerámicos (ASCER)
page_table_section: Public summary; production, electricity, PV self-consumption
used_value: 423 million m2 production; 1.6 TWh sector electricity; 12% PV self-consumption
transformation: Sector totals retained; electricity absolute value cross-checked against ASCER public communication. No company value inferred directly.
license: Publicly accessible sector communication; attribution retained

used_value: 94% of national production originates in Castellón province; 80% of sector companies located there
transformation: Used only to justify geographic representativeness of Castellón, not to allocate plant-level consumption.

used_value: more than 100 ceramic-tile manufacturers represented; about 95% of Spanish production
transformation: Together with 1.6 TWh sector electricity, supports only an order-of-magnitude representative scale. Case annual load is rounded to 15 GWh/year to avoid false plant-level precision.

page_table_section: Section 1.5, p. 14: Prices and energy in Spain
used_value: Monthly arithmetic day-ahead means; 2025 annual inter-year result 65.28 EUR/MWh
transformation: Monthly means are preserved exactly; missing raw hourly series is represented by a deterministic intra-month proxy. This is a wholesale energy-price proxy, not an industrial bill.
license: Public OMIE report; OptiDecarb stores transformed/calibrated summary statistics rather than redistributing a raw market dataset.

page_table_section: PV performance and hourly data/API documentation
used_value: Method/source family: PVGIS 5.3, SARAH-3, fixed grid-connected PV, 14% default system losses
transformation: Official tool methodology; exact Castelló monthly extraction is documented separately as a public PVGIS-derived proxy because raw API download was unavailable in the build sandbox.
geography: Castelló de la Plana representative city location
reference_year: PVGIS multi-year climatic data through 2023 for v5.3
license: PVGIS information/results are free to use; source acknowledgement retained (JRC usage conditions).

document_title: Solar Panels in Castelló de la Plana, Spain
used_value: 8,084 kWh/year for 5 kWp (1,616.8 kWh/kWp); monthly production; 39.98567 N, -0.04935 E/W longitude; 14% loss; 37 degree optimal inclination; 2 degree azimuth
transformation: Monthly kWh divided by 5 kWp, then deterministic hourly solar geometry rescaled monthly. Not raw PVGIS hourly data.
license: Public webpage; underlying data attributed to EU PVGIS v5.3

page_table_section: Generation total and non-renewable generation/emissions sections
used_value: 272,201 GWh national generation; 29.5 million tCO2eq generation emissions
transformation: Derived location-style generation factor = 29.5e6 tCO2eq / 272.201e6 MWh = 108.375 kgCO2eq/MWh; no export credit.
license: Public Red Eléctrica report; attribution retained

document_title: Programas de incentivos de autoconsumo y almacenamiento (RD 477/2021)
publisher: Instituto para la Diversificación y Ahorro de la Energía
page_table_section: Cost ranges for PV self-consumption and storage
transformation: Case central PV CAPEX 700 EUR/kW and 300 EUR/kWh-equivalent two-hour battery benchmark lie inside the official screening ranges; they remain model assumptions, not quotes.

page_table_section: Solar PV and enabling technologies / battery storage
used_value: Global PV installed cost 691 USD/kW; Europe surveyed PV O&M 7.3 USD/kW-year; utility BESS installed cost 192 USD/kWh
transformation: Used as an international reasonableness cross-check only. Case CAPEX is anchored to Spanish IDAE ranges; PV OPEX is set to 7 EUR/kW-year as a rounded European proxy.

used_value: continuous base + modest daytime uplift + 8% weekend reduction + mild seasonality + fixed-seed variability
WACC 5%; project life 15y; PV life 25y; battery life 15y
transformation: Explicit screening assumptions tested with sensitivity; no claim of ceramic-sector WACC.

used_value: 240 EUR/kWh energy + 120 EUR/kW power; for a 2h system this corresponds to 300 EUR/kWh total
transformation: Transparent modelling split of a 300 EUR/kWh central storage benchmark lying within IDAE's 200-700 EUR/kWh range; no external source supplies this exact split.

Conservative screening assumption because there is no universal industrial export remuneration and the wholesale proxy does not reconstruct negative-price hours. Sensitivity can test alternative values separately.
